description: Cutting and cleaning narration, interview and handheld-recorder recordings for documentary and podcast mixes: sentence-exact cuts with measured air and fades, breaths and laughs kept, room-tone fills and floors, spectral repair of coughs, throat-clears and thumps (opendubstage specrepair), de-rumble and the dialogue chain order, sentence-level levelling, and what neural restoration (DeepFilterNet, Resemble Enhance, VoiceFixer, de-reverb) may and may not do. Use whenever someone is editing spoken-word audio, asks why a cut sounds clipped or "switched on", wants to remove a cough / click / rumble / hiss, is choosing or evaluating a denoiser or enhancer, or is tempted to run an AI cleanup over interview tape. Do NOT use for music restoration or for matching one voice to another (that is voice-matching).
